watchRooms.title: Watch room
watchRooms.intro: Watch this live channel in sync with up to 8 friends, with a private side chat. Rooms are invite-only.
watchRooms.createFailed: The room could not be opened. Try again.
watchRooms.band.minor: Under-18 room: only members under 18 can join.
watchRooms.band.adult: Adult room: only members 18 or older can join.
watchRooms.mature: Mature content: adults only. Every member has confirmed mature viewing.
watchRooms.invite.label: Invite link
watchRooms.invite.hint: Anyone with this link can ask to join. Share it only with friends.
watchRooms.invite.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it yourself.
watchRooms.join.title: You're invited to a watch room
watchRooms.join.intro: Join to watch this channel in sync with the room and chat with its members.
watchRooms.sync: Your player follows the slowest member, never more than 5 seconds behind live.
watchRooms.retention: Room messages are kept for 30 days after the room ends, so reports can be reviewed, then deleted.
watchRooms.chat.label: Room chat
watchRooms.chat.filtered: Your message was not sent because it matched a channel filter.
watchRooms.reportDescription: Platform moderators review room reports with a copy of the room's messages and members. The channel's moderators never see them.
watchRooms.leaveDescription: You'll stop syncing with the room and leave its chat.
watchRooms.closeDescription: Everyone leaves and the invite stops working.
watchRooms.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
watchRooms.ended.title: This room has ended
watchRooms.ended.description: {reason, select, host_closed {The host closed it.} host_left {The host left.} empty {Everyone left.} broadcast_ended {The broadcast ended.} mature {The broadcast is now labelled mature.} moderation {It was closed for safety reasons.} host_deleted {The host's account was deleted.} other {It is closed.}}
watchRooms.refusal.room_age_band: This room is for another age group. Rooms never mix members under 18 and adults.
watchRooms.refusal.room_birth_date_unkno: Rooms need a birth date on your account, and yours is missing or invalid.
watchRooms.refusal.room_mature_minor: This channel is labelled mature, so rooms on it are for adults only.
watchRooms.refusal.room_mature_unconfirm: This channel is labelled mature. Confirm you want to see mature content first.
watchRooms.refusal.room_suspended: Your account is suspended, so you can't use rooms right now.
watchRooms.refusal.room_invite_invalid: This invite link is no longer valid. Ask the host for a new one.
watchRooms.refusal.room_not_live: Rooms are for live broadcasts, and this channel is not live.
watchRooms.evidence.title: Room transcript
watchRooms.evidence.intro: Copied when the report was filed. People are shown by account.
watchRooms.evidence.empty: The room had no messages when it was reported.
watchRooms.evidence.truncated: {count, plural, one {Only the newest message was kept.} other {Only the newest # messages were kept.}}
watchRooms.evidence.unreadable: This report's room transcript could not be read.
